VULN.TITLE: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal
VULN.DIAGNOSIS: The Apache HTTP Server version on this host is affected by a path traversal flaw.
VULN.CONSEQUENCE: An attacker can read files outside the document root.
VULN.SOLUTION: Upgrade to the latest Apache HTTP Server release.

VULN.TITLE: SSL Certificate - Subject Common Name Does Not Match Server FQDN
VULN.DIAGNOSIS: The certificate common name does not match the host name.
VULN.CONSEQUENCE: Clients may warn about the certificate.
VULN.SOLUTION: Use a certificate issued for the server FQDN.
